title: 2 Corinthians Bible Quiz - Chapter 12
description: Ten questions on 2 Corinthians 12: visions and revelations, the thorn in the flesh, grace that is sufficient, and a third visit the writer is ready to make.

questions.text: Into what was the man in Christ caught up, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The writer says he knows a man in Christ who, fourteen years ago, was caught up into the third heaven.

questions.text: What did that man hear when he was caught up into Paradise?
questions.explanation: He was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

answers.text: Unspeakable words that may not be uttered
A new song sung by all the saints
A warning about the last days

questions.text: What was given to the writer because of the exceeding greatness of the revelations?
questions.explanation: He says that a thorn in the flesh was given to him, a messenger of Satan to torment him, so that he should not be exalted excessively.

questions.text: How many times did he beg the Lord that this thing might depart from him?
questions.explanation: Concerning the thorn he says he begged the Lord three times that it might depart from him.

questions.text: What did the Lord say to him when he begged for the thorn to depart?
questions.explanation: The Lord said to him that his grace is sufficient for him, for his power is made perfect in weakness.

answers.text: My grace is sufficient for you
My power will take away your weakness
My grace will be given when you are strong
My strength is made perfect in the law

questions.text: How does the writer finish the thought that he takes pleasure in weaknesses?
questions.explanation: He takes pleasure in weaknesses and distresses for Christ's sake, because when he is weak, then he is strong.

answers.text: Because he will be spared trouble
Because when he is weak, then he is strong
Because the Lord counts his labors

questions.text: What does he say was worked among them in all perseverance?
questions.explanation: He says the signs of an apostle were worked among them in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

answers.text: Signs and wonders and mighty works

questions.text: As he gets ready to come a third time, what does he say he seeks?
questions.explanation: He says he will not be a burden to them, for he seeks not their possessions, but them.

answers.text: A place to stay in their city

questions.text: Whom did he exhort and send to them with the brother?
questions.explanation: He says he exhorted Titus and sent the brother with him, and asks whether Titus took any advantage of them.

questions.text: What does he fear he might find among them when he comes?
questions.explanation: He is afraid that when he comes there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots.

answers.text: Strife, jealousy and outbursts of anger
Hunger and poverty in the city
